methods.estimand: Descriptive task counts on the final repair-assisted panel; each task once.
methods.lag: Ordinal model-index distance; not time, parameter count or training compute.
methods.scale: IQR of the same four model task means; inclusive linear quantiles (Hyndman-Fan type 7). With sorted a<=b<=c<=d: Q1=.25a+.75b; Q3=.75c+.25d.
methods.formula: R = preferred-direction sign * (later score - earlier score) / panel IQR
methods.threshold_status: Analyst-selected post-hoc sensitivity bands, not validated small/large effect standards or equivalence margins.
methods.within_band: Absolute normalized gap at or below threshold (plus boundary tolerance), including raw numerical ties. Not evidence of equivalence or randomness.
methods.missing_or_zero_scale: Missing four-model scores: normalization not estimable. Zero IQR: no ratio; numerical pair ties within band, other pairs not estimable. Never add epsilon to the denominator.
methods.invariance: Ratio is invariant to positive affine changes of native score units/origin, apart from the separately retained native numerical-tie tolerance. Not invariant to nonlinear metric transformations.
limitations: Only four selected model points define each spread: estimates can be unstable and change with the model roster.
A large ratio can still be a tiny or practically unimportant native difference. This is not Cohen d, biological variability, error reduction, a z-score or a signal-to-noise ratio.
IQR is a robust spread statistic in general; that does not make this four-point application a robust inferential result.
Lags share tasks/models and are not independent repetitions. No pooled lag p-values, significance, confidence intervals or scaling-law fit are claimed.
Convenience tasks, overlapping sources, unequal wrappers and selective repairs limit generalization. J08 GPT-4.1 has a documented manual training-budget adaptation.
C2ST retains the original lower-is-better direction, but the diagnostic target is 0.5; near-chance ordering need not indicate a better sampler.
methods.stronger_next_analysis: Predeclare task-specific worthwhile-effect/equivalence margins; rescore with paired resampling of independent people, animals or recordings; preserve hierarchy and metric aggregation; repeat model generations under matched conditions. Report unresolved intervals rather than forcing small/large labels.

citations.title: NIST: Measures of Scale
citations.supports: IQR as a robust measure of spread, not the selected thresholds or conclusions.
